one_liner: Open-source Firebase alternative providing hosted Postgres, auth, storage, and edge functions with a Management API.

auth.evidence_quote: OAuth2 allows your application to generate tokens on behalf of a Supabase user, providing secure and limited access to their account without requiring their credentials.
auth.notes: Personal access tokens (PATs) are manually generated bearer tokens for direct use; OAuth2 is documented explicitly for third-party apps acting on behalf of users.

access.evidence_quote: PATs are tokens with a custom expiry that you manually generate to access the Management API.
access.notes: Free Supabase account can generate a PAT and free-tier projects immediately.

api.evidence_quote: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard for connecting AI agents and LLM tools to data sources and services.
api.notes: Official MCP server hosted per-project (custom MCP URL from dashboard); repo also referenced at github.com/supabase/mcp. Breadth is an estimate not counted from a reference index this pass.

verdict.rationale: Free account, PAT/OAuth2 auth, and an official per-project MCP server support building now.
